factual_claims.source_evidence: Bank Financing section: 'For the year 2025, approximately SEK 44,900 million was raised across 24 transactions... Heimstaden's subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad, ended the quarter with SEK 23,449 million of unutilised credit facilities.' (Note: SEK 44,900m + other financing = ~SEK 59.5bn total)

factual_claims.claim: The group generated SEK 2,742 million of operating cash flow and ended the year with SEK 4,179 million in cash.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow section: 'Net cash flow from operating activities was SEK 1,023 million (1,067)... Closing balance - Cash and cash equivalents 4,179 4,179'

factual_claims.claim: The parent company reported a loss before tax of SEK 33 million, improved from SEK 273 million, and no dividends were proposed.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Heimstaden AB Standalone section: 'The loss before tax was SEK -33 million (-273)... It is proposed that the funds... is to be carried forward. No dividend shall be paid...'

factual_claims.claim: Fitch affirmed Heimstaden's B- rating but revised the outlook to negative, while an arbitration award in favour of Heimstaden confirmed no breach of the Heimstaden Bostad shareholders' agreement.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 2025 in Brief section: 'In January 2025, Fitch ratings affirmed the ‘B-‘ and revised the Outlook to Negative... In December 2025, an award in favour of Heimstaden was received... confirming that there was no breach in the Shareholders Agreement of Heimstaden Bostad'
